孩子用AI写作业，你怎么看？（教育时评）: Children Using AI to Do Homework, What Do You Think? (Education Commentary)
寒假已至，一些家长发现：孩子在家写作业，一遇到难题便求助AI，一篇作文瞬间生成，: Winter vacation has arrived, and some parents have discovered: when children do homework at home and encounter difficult problems, they immediately turn to AI; an essay is generated in an instant, and a math problem gets an answer in seconds
当AI以这般姿态介入学习过程，轻松代劳那些原本需要苦思冥想的学业任务时，家长和老: When AI intervenes in the learning process in this manner, easily taking over academic tasks that originally required deep thought, parents and teachers cannot help but worry: if this continues, will children lose their capacity for independent thinking?
当AI似乎可以回答一切难题时，教育应当教会孩子哪些关键知识和能力: When AI seems capable of answering all difficult questions, what key knowledge and abilities should education teach children?
当前，推动人工智能教育全学段覆盖已成为共识，这既是激发学生创造潜能、提升教育品质: Currently, promoting full-segment coverage of artificial intelligence education across all grades has become a consensus; this is both a concrete pathway to stimulating students' creative potential and improving educational quality, and also an important practice in seizing opportunities from the new round of technological revolution and responding to the national strategy of technological self-reliance and self-strengthening
教育部发布《中小学人工智能通识教育指南（2025年版）》和《中小学生成式人工智能: The Ministry of Education has released the "Guidelines for General Education in Artificial Intelligence for Primary and Secondary Schools (2025 Edition)" and the "Guidelines for the Use of Generative Artificial Intelligence by Primary and Secondary School Students (2025 Edition)," clarifying usage standards for each school level and emphasizing vigilance against over-reliance on AI tools
具体来看，学生应避免直接照搬AI生成的内容完成作业，教师不应将生成式人工智能作为: Specifically, students should avoid directly copying AI-generated content to complete assignments, and teachers should not use generative artificial intelligence as a replacement for the teaching subject
AI是一面镜子，照见的是学习的态度与方式: AI is a mirror that reflects one's attitude and approach to learning
若简单复制，AI不过是“答案生成器”: If merely copied, AI is nothing but an "answer generator"
面对人工智能技术带来的机遇和挑战，各方都应主动引导，帮助孩子建立与AI之间的健康: Facing both opportunities and challenges brought by artificial intelligence technology, all parties should take the initiative to guide and help children establish a healthy interactive relationship with AI, clarifying usage standards and boundaries
AI是一座桥梁，连接的是问题的多元解决路径: AI is a bridge connecting diverse problem-solving pathways
形成适应AI时代发展的价值观念、必备品格和关键能力，对教育环节中的每一个主体都至: Developing values, essential qualities, and critical abilities suited to the AI era is crucial for every stakeholder in the educational process
比如，借助日新月异的AI工具，教师可以优化教学思路，开展实时学情分析，构建交互式: For example, with the help of rapidly evolving AI tools, teachers can optimize their teaching strategies, conduct real-time learning analytics, and develop interactive curricula
AI只是工具，决定工具好坏的，是使用工具的方法: AI is merely a tool; what determines whether a tool is good or bad is the method of using it
AI能模拟对话，却无法复刻面对面交流的笑意: AI can simulate dialogue, but it cannot replicate the warmth of face-to-face communication
AI能生成答案，却难以承载共同探索时的默契: AI can generate answers, but it cannot carry the understanding that comes from joint exploration
AI时代来临，促使我们更加珍视提出真问题、探索新路径的能力: With the arrival of the AI era, we are prompted to cherish even more the capacity to pose genuine questions and explore new pathways
我们要努力的，不是隔绝技术或放任自流，而是教会孩子们如何与AI共创，从而获得更全: What we must strive for is not to shut out technology or let it run wild, but to teach children how to co-create with AI, thereby gaining more comprehensive and enriched growth
科技艺术呈现新样貌: Technology and Art Present New Appearances
当下，“人工智能”等技术正掀起新的科技革命浪潮: Currently, technologies such as "artificial intelligence" are unleashing a new wave of technological revolution
如刘佳玉创作的《丛林的预言》，基于其自研的人工智能系统“Jiayu*”，以她过往: For instance, "Prophecy of the Jungle" created by Liu Jiayu is based on her self-developed artificial intelligence system "Jiayu*," using her past digital image creations as training material, reorganizing personal memories within the machine's own perceptual logic, and generating natural landscapes—mountains, forests, streams, and various biological forms—through the form of dynamic particles
与之对应，韩娅娟作品《AI气候治理：回溯性的当下》则引入当下主流的AI大模型，对: In contrast, Han Yajuan's work "AI Climate Governance: A Retrospective Present" introduces the current mainstream large language models of AI to simulate future climate governance
在赵梓君作品《墨山》中，两幅巨型实体山水画卷与一幅空白画布并列悬挂，由AI算法动: In Zhao Zijun's work "Ink Mountain," two giant physical landscape painting scrolls and a blank canvas are hung side by side, with mountain and water images dynamically generated by AI algorithms projected onto the blank canvas, thereby transforming the grand momentum and dynamic charm of traditional Chinese landscape painting into a three-dimensional space that viewers can explore and inhabit
同时，AI技术的发展，也对美术基础教学提出新挑战: At the same time, the development of AI technology has also posed new challenges to basic art instruction
师生以“导演视角”探索经典画作形体组合与空间构建，并借助AI技术搜索大师文献、作: Teachers and students explore the composition of forms and spatial construction in classical paintings from a "director's perspective," and leverage AI technology to search for master references and work materials, generate knowledge maps of artistic styles, individually fill gaps in art history for different students, and conduct self-directed and cultivating learning
在这两个环节，学生以自建场景为写生对象，在强调手工实操的基础上结合AI技术，融入: In these two phases, students use self-created scenarios as drawing subjects, combining AI technology with manual practice, infusing imaginative ideas, designing plots, endowing narratives, and strengthening subjective expression
同时，该模式坚持手绘训练与AI技术有机融合，既保留美术基础教学的实践重心，又借助: At the same time, this model adheres to an organic integration of hand-drawing training and AI technology, both preserving the practical focus of fine arts foundational education and leveraging new technology to broaden artistic horizons.
